questions.question: An employee claims ₹20 for each kilometre when he travels by taxi and ₹10 for each kilometre if he travels by his own car. In one week, he claimed ₹2,200 for travelling 120 km. How many kilometres did he travel by taxi?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let taxi km = x ⇒ own car = (120 − x)

Extra earning in taxi = 10 per km

Total extra = 2200 − (120 × 10) = 1000

⇒ 10x = 1000 ⇒ x = 100

**∴ Answer = 100 km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Taxi rate = 20 per km, Own car rate = 10 per km, Total distance = 120 km, Total claim = 2200

**Formula used:**

Total amount = (rate × distance)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let taxi distance = x km

⇒ Own car distance = 120 − x

⇒ Total claim = 20x + 10(120 − x)

⇒ 20x + 1200 − 10x = 2200

⇒ 10x + 1200 = 2200

⇒ 10x = 1000

⇒ x = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation Method

Set unknown distances and form equation using total amount.

Difference Method

Use rate difference to quickly find contribution from higher rate.

Unitary Concept

Per km earning helps build equation easily.

Check Method

Verify by substituting values back into original condition.

questions.question: The number of prime numbers lying between 376 and 384 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check numbers between 376 and 384 ⇒ 377, 378, 379, 380, 381, 382, 383

Even numbers are not prime ⇒ remove 378, 380, 382

Check remaining: 377 = 13 × 29 (not prime), 381 divisible by 3

379 and 383 are prime

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Find prime numbers between 376 and 384

**Formula used:**

A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself

**Calculation:**

⇒ Numbers: 377, 378, 379, 380, 381, 382, 383

⇒ 377 = 13 × 29 (not prime)

⇒ 378 even (not prime)

⇒ 379 not divisible by 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17 ⇒ prime

⇒ 380 even (not prime)

⇒ 381 divisible by 3 ⇒ not prime

⇒ 382 even (not prime)

⇒ 383 not divisible by primes up to √383 ⇒ prime

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number Definition

A prime number has exactly two distinct factors: 1 and itself.

Even Number Rule

All even numbers except 2 are not prime.

Divisibility Test

Check divisibility up to √n to confirm primality.

Small Prime Checks

Test divisibility by 2, 3, 5, 7 first for quick elimination.

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 324 and their HCF is 3. Then their LCM will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use relation: Product = HCF × LCM

⇒ 324 = 3 × LCM

⇒ LCM = 324 ÷ 3

⇒ LCM = 108

**∴ Answer = 108**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Product of two numbers = 324, HCF = 3

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

**Calculation:**

⇒ 324 = 3 × LCM

⇒ LCM = 324 ÷ 3

⇒ LCM = 108

**∴ The correct answer is 108.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF–LCM Relation

For any two numbers: Product = HCF × LCM.

HCF Meaning

HCF is the greatest number that divides both numbers exactly.

LCM Meaning

LCM is the smallest number divisible by both numbers.

Prime Factorization

Another way to find HCF and LCM using prime factors.

questions.question: A contractor employed 24 men to build a wall, and they completed the work in 12 days. After working together for 5 days, 6 men leave the job and do not return. How many days more will the remaining men take to complete the work?

questions.question: The average age of 48 students of a class is 19 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 20 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of students = 48 × 19 = 912

Total age with teacher = 49 × 20 = 980

Teacher's age = 980 − 912 = 68

**∴ Answer = 68 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

48 students, average = 19 years; with teacher, average = 20 years

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number of persons

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of students = 48 × 19 = 912

⇒ Total persons including teacher = 49

⇒ Total age including teacher = 49 × 20 = 980

⇒ Teacher's age = 980 − 912 = 68

**∴ The correct answer is 68 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of items

Total Calculation

Total = Average × Number of items

Combined Average

When new person added, recalculate total first.

Shortcut Concept

Extra total due to new average gives the new person's value.

questions.question: A car covers three successive 20 km distances at speeds of 10 km/hr, 20 km/hr and 40 km/hr, respectively. Its average speed (in km/hr) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equal distances ⇒ Average speed = 3ab c / (ab + bc + ca)

⇒ = (3 × 10 × 20 × 40) / (10×20 + 20×40 + 40×10)

⇒ = 24000 / (200 + 800 + 400)

⇒ = 24000 / 1400

**∴ Answer = 17(1)/(7) km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three distances = 20 km each, speeds = 10, 20, 40 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time₁ = 20 ÷ 10 = 2 hr

⇒ Time₂ = 20 ÷ 20 = 1 hr

⇒ Time₃ = 20 ÷ 40 = 1/2 hr

⇒ Total distance = 60 km

⇒ Total time = 2 + 1 + 1/2 = 7/2 hr

⇒ Average speed = 60 ÷ (7/2)

⇒ = 60 × 2/7 = 120/7 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 17(1)/(7) km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Equal Distance Shortcut

For equal distances: Avg = 3abc / (ab + bc + ca)

Time Calculation

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Important Note

Average of speeds ≠ Average speed unless time is equal.

questions.question: By how much is 60% of 45 greater than (2)/(5) of 15?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

60% of 45 = 0.6 × 45 = 27

2/5 of 15 = (2/5) × 15 = 6

Difference = 27 − 6 = 21

**∴ Answer = 21**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

60% of 45 and 2/5 of 15

**Formula used:**

Percentage = value/100, Fraction = part of whole

**Calculation:**

⇒ 60% of 45 = (60/100) × 45

⇒ = (3/5) × 45 = 27

⇒ 2/5 of 15 = (2/5) × 15 = 6

⇒ Difference = 27 − 6 = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

x% = x/100 ⇒ 60% = 3/5

Fraction Concept

a/b of number = (a/b) × number

Simplification Tip

Convert percentages into fractions for faster calculation.

Difference Concept

Find both values separately, then subtract.

questions.question: A car goes to a place at a speed of 24 km/hr and returns from there at a speed of 28 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to 2 decimal places) of the car in the entire journey is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal distances: Average speed = (2ab)/(a + b)

⇒ (2 × 24 × 28) / (24 + 28)

⇒ 1344 / 52

⇒ 25.846…

**∴ Answer = 25.85 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed going = 24 km/hr, Speed returning = 28 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let distance = d km (one way)

⇒ Time₁ = d/24, Time₂ = d/28

⇒ Total distance = 2d

⇒ Total time = d/24 + d/28

⇒ = d(1/24 + 1/28)

⇒ = d( (7 + 6) / 168 ) = 13d/168

⇒ Average speed = 2d ÷ (13d/168)

⇒ = 2d × 168 / 13d

⇒ = 336 / 13 = 25.846…

**∴ The correct answer is 25.85 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Harmonic Mean Concept

For equal distances: Average speed = 2ab/(a + b)

Time Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Important Note

Average speed ≠ (a + b)/2 when distances are equal.

Shortcut Usage

Use harmonic mean directly for two-speed round trip problems.

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹4,200 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use formula: A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

⇒ A = 4200 × (1.1)²

⇒ A = 4200 × 1.21

⇒ A = 5082

**∴ Answer = ₹5082**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 4200, Rate = 10%, Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Compound Amount = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ First year amount = 4200 + 10% of 4200

⇒ = 4200 + 420 = 4620

⇒ Second year amount = 4620 + 10% of 4620

⇒ = 4620 + 462 = 5082

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5082.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Simple vs Compound

CI grows on previous amount, SI grows on principal only.

Successive Growth

Each year multiplies the amount by (1 + r/100).

Quick Square Trick

(1.1)² = 1.21 helps faster calculation.

questions.question: Find the single equivalent discount (rounded off to two decimal places) for successive discounts of 18%, 6% and 25%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount = 1 − (1 − 0.18)(1 − 0.06)(1 − 0.25)

⇒ = 1 − (0.82 × 0.94 × 0.75)

⇒ = 1 − 0.5781

⇒ = 0.4219

**∴ Answer = 42.19%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive discounts = 18%, 6%, 25%

**Formula used:**

Final price = MP × (1 − d1)(1 − d2)(1 − d3)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let MP = 100

⇒ After 18% discount ⇒ 100 × 0.82 = 82

⇒ After 6% discount ⇒ 82 × 0.94 = 77.08

⇒ After 25% discount ⇒ 77.08 × 0.75 = 57.81

⇒ Net discount = 100 − 57.81 = 42.19%

**∴ The correct answer is 42.19%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net Discount = 1 − (1 − d1)(1 − d2)(1 − d3)

Important Note

Successive discounts are multiplied, not added.

Shortcut Tip

Use decimals for faster multiplication.

Assumption Method

Take MP = 100 to simplify calculations.

questions.question: The ratio of length, breadth and height of a cuboid box is in the ratio 5 : 4 : 4 while the areas of the three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box are 160 cm² , 64 cm² and 40 cm² , respectively. Find the lateral surface area of the box (in cm² ).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let dimensions = 5x, 4x, 4x

Adjacent face areas: (5x × 4x), (4x × 4x), (5x × 4x)

⇒ 20x², 16x², 20x²

Given one face = 64 ⇒ 16x² = 64 ⇒ x² = 4 ⇒ x = 2

Lateral surface area = 2h(l + b) = 2 × 4x × (5x + 4x)

⇒ = 2 × 8 × 18 = 288

**∴ Answer = 288 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of dimensions = 5 : 4 : 4

Face areas = 160, 64, 40

**Formula used:**

Area of faces = l×b, b×h, l×h

 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• l b h 

Let l = 5x, b = 4x, h = 4x

Areas: lb = 20x², bh = 16x², lh = 20x²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 16x² = 64 ⇒ x² = 4 ⇒ x = 2

⇒ Dimensions = 10, 8, 8

⇒ LSA = 2h(l + b)

⇒ = 2 × 8 × (10 + 8)

⇒ = 16 × 18 = 288

**∴ The correct answer is 288 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cuboid Face Areas

Three adjacent faces: l×b, b×h, l×h

Lateral Surface Area

LSA = 2h(l + b)

Ratio Concept

Dimensions in ratio ⇒ multiply by common factor x

Square Relation

Area involves x², so solve for x carefully

questions.question: If Akhil is as much older than Vijay as he is younger than Karthik, and sum of the ages of Vijay and Karthik is 84 years, then find the age of Akhil.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If Akhil is equally older and younger ⇒ he is the average

Akhil = (Vijay + Karthik) ÷ 2

⇒ = 84 ÷ 2

⇒ = 42

**∴ Answer = 42 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Akhil is as much older than Vijay as he is younger than Karthik

Vijay + Karthik = 84

**Formula used:**

Equal difference ⇒ A − V = K − A

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Akhil = A, Vijay = V, Karthik = K

⇒ A − V = K − A

⇒ 2A = V + K

⇒ 2A = 84

⇒ A = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

If one value is equally distant from two values, it is their average.

Linear Equation

A − V = K − A ⇒ forms simple equation.

Shortcut Tip

Middle age = average of extremes.

Symmetry Concept

Equal difference creates balance around the middle value.

questions.question: If the length of a cuboid is 21 cm, breadth is 2 cm and the volume of the cuboid is 9198 cm³ , then find the height of the cuboid.
questions.solution:

⇒ h = Volume ÷ (l × b)

⇒ h = 9198 ÷ (21 × 2)

⇒ h = 9198 ÷ 42 = 219

**∴ Answer = 219 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length = 21 cm, Breadth = 2 cm, Volume = 9198 cm³

**Formula used:**

Volume of cuboid = l × b × h

 
•

• 21 cm 2 cm h 

l = 21 cm, b = 2 cm, h = ?

Volume = 9198 cm³

**Calculation:**

⇒ 21 × 2 × h = 9198

⇒ 42h = 9198

⇒ h = 9198 ÷ 42

⇒ h = 219 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 219 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: The marked price of a washing machine is ₹45,000. A shopkeeper allows a discount of 44% and gets a profit of 80%. What is the cost price of the washing machine?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After 44% discount ⇒ SP = 56% of 45000 = 25200

Profit = 80% ⇒ SP = 1.8 × CP

⇒ CP = 25200 ÷ 1.8

⇒ CP = 14000

**∴ Answer = ₹14000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 45000, Discount = 44%, Profit = 80%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount)/100 and SP = CP × (1 + Profit/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP after discount = 45000 × 56/100 = 25200

⇒ SP = 1.8 × CP

⇒ 25200 = 1.8 × CP

⇒ CP = 25200 ÷ 1.8

⇒ CP = 14000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Selling Price Formula

SP = MP × (100 − Discount)%

Profit Relation

SP = CP × (1 + Profit%)

Shortcut Tip

questions.question: The sum of three numbers is 270. If the ratio of the second number to the first number is 2:12 and that of the third number to the second number is 5:10, then find the second number.

questions.question: In an election, there are two candidates. The winner obtains 49% votes of the total number of voters in the electoral list and defeats the other contestant by 120 votes. If 10% of the voters did not vote, find the total number of voters in the electoral list.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total voters = x

Votes polled = 90% of x

Winner votes = 49% of x

Loser votes = 90% − 49% = 41% of x

Difference = 49% − 41% = 8% of x = 120

⇒ x = 120 × 100 ÷ 8 = 1500

**∴ Answer = 1500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Winner gets 49% of total voters, 10% did not vote

**Formula used:**

Total votes polled = 90% of total voters

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total voters = x

⇒ Votes polled = 90% of x = 0.9x

⇒ Winner votes = 49% of x = 0.49x

⇒ Loser votes = 0.9x − 0.49x = 0.41x

⇒ Difference = 0.49x − 0.41x = 0.08x

⇒ 0.08x = 120

⇒ x = 120 ÷ 0.08 = 1500

**∴ The correct answer is 1500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Voting Concept

Total votes polled = Total voters − Non-voters

Percentage Difference

Difference in votes = difference in percentages × total

Shortcut Tip

Work directly with percentages to avoid long equations

Key Insight

Winner percentage is based on total voters, not votes polled

questions.question: Solve: ((6.9)³ + (2.8)³ + (6.3)³ - 3 times 6.9 times 2.8 times 6.3)/((6.9)² + (2.8)² + (6.3)² - 6.9 times 2.8 - 2.8 times 6.3 - 6.9 times 6.3)

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc) / (a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca) = a + b + c

⇒ Answer = 6.9 + 2.8 + 6.3

⇒ = 16

**∴ Answer = 16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc) / (a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca)

**Concept Used:**

Algebraic identity simplification

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let a = 6.9, b = 2.8, c = 6.3

⇒ Apply identity:

⇒ (a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc) ÷ (a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca) = a + b + c

⇒ = 6.9 + 2.8 + 6.3

⇒ = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Important Identity

(a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc) = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca)

Shortcut Tip

If expression matches identity form, cancel directly

Time Saving

Avoid cube calculations by recognizing patterns

Exam Strategy

Always check for identities before expanding expressions

questions.question: In a quadrilateral IJKL, angle I = 11^circ and angle J = 79^circ . The bisectors of angle K and angle L meet at Z. What is the measure of angle LZK ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of angles in quadrilateral = 360°

⇒ K + L = 360 − (I + J) = 360 − (11 + 79) = 270°

Angle between bisectors = 180 − (K + L)/2

⇒ = 180 − (270/2) = 180 − 135 = 45°

**∴ Answer = 45°**
